verses.1: Oh, how beautiful are those golden crowns of Ephraim! And how magnificent is that crown of Zebi, which rests upon the head of Giy-Shmanim. It’s like a crown made of gold.
verses.2: See, it’s strong and powerful for the Lord, like a river flowing from a negative direction. It’s like the power of great waters that wash over the earth. It’s something that can be controlled by the Lord himself.
verses.3: In their feet, they carry the burdens of those who are burdened with heavy loads.
verses.4: And there would be a crown of thorns on His head, just as it was before the crucifixion. Those who see Him will recognize Him from afar, and He will be pierced by a spear.
verses.5: On that day, Jehovah will be the ruler of all nations. He will bring glory and honor to his people.
verses.6: And let the spirit of judgment be upon those who judge, and let those who return from battle be restored to peace.
verses.7: And also, those who were in the pit fell down. In exchange for their services, they became priests and prophets. They were swallowed up from the pit; they fell from the service they had performed. They were destroyed by their own actions.
verses.8: For all our messengers were filled with filth and dirt, without any place to be hidden.
verses.9: Who will understand wisdom? Who will comprehend the meaning of those words that come from ancient times, from the fields of the past.
verses.10: For the commandment is a commandment; it must be obeyed. It’s a strict rule that must be followed. It’s something that must be done immediately.
verses.11: For in the language of anger and in other words, he will speak to this people.
verses.12: For those who said to them, “This is the moment of rest; let us abandon all anxiety and relaxation.” But I do not want to be part of that moment.
verses.13: And it shall be a command of the LORD for them to do these things. They shall go forth and fail, and be scattered and captured.
verses.14: Therefore, listen to what the LORD says, you people of Lachish, the people of this city who are in Jerusalem.
verses.15: For you said that you have made a covenant with death. With Shaul, we made a promise that no one would come to us again. But we were deceived; we were trapped in lies.
verses.16: Therefore, thus said Adonai YHWH: “I will establish a covenant in Zion. I will make it a place of peace and harmony. The righteous shall not be disturbed.”
verses.17: And I have established judgments and righteousness for those who seek them. The darkness will be dispelled, and the hidden waters will be revealed.
verses.18: And by your covenant, you will be spared from death. You will not see the day of judgment come. It will pass by, and you will become like those who are forgotten.
verses.19: From here on, he will take you with him. For in the morning, he will pass by day and night. It’s just a matter of time before you understand what he means.
verses.20: Because the path is narrow, and the way ahead is difficult to navigate.
verses.21: For as Mount Parnas rises, so will Jehovah stand in his wilderness. He will do what is right, and he will worship his God. The foreigners will be forced to worship his God.
verses.22: And now, do not let them strengthen their power over you. For all things will be destroyed. I have heard from the temple of Jehovah, the army of heaven, that all things on earth will be destroyed.
verses.23: Hear my voice, and listen to my words. Pay attention and heed my instructions.
verses.24: Today, the seed will be sown; it will then grow and transform its land.
verses.25: Or maybe her face was covered with hair, and her body was covered with feathers and hair. Her limbs were also covered with feathers.
verses.26: And he will be brought before his God’s judgment.
verses.27: For a sword and a spear cannot be placed on the same place. They must be hung up in a separate place. A sword is hung up in a rack, and so too is the spear.
verses.28: The bread is fine, for no one will ever be able to destroy it. Its wheels and spokes remain intact, and they cannot be destroyed.
verses.29: And also, along with the armies of Jehovah, came a wonderful plan to increase their power.
